editorial:
Fresh off a brutal on-set accident that nearly ended his career, stuntman Colt Seavers is pulled back into the chaos when the movie star he doubles for goes missing. What starts as a simple favor quickly turns into a wild ride through Hollywood conspiracies, dangerous stunts, and second chances at love. Ryan Gosling brings his usual charm to Colt, while Emily Blunt shines as Jody, the director and Colt's ex. The chemistry between them is the heart of the movie, and the action never lets up. You get big set pieces, funny banter, and a surprisingly sweet romance all wrapped into one crowd-pleasing package.

The stunts are the real star here, with practical effects and jaw-dropping sequences that feel fresh in a world of CGI overload. The pacing is snappy, though the middle section drags slightly as the mystery unfolds. Some jokes land better than others, but the overall energy keeps you smiling. If you enjoy action comedies with heart, this is a must-watch. Perfect for a fun movie night with friends or family.
endingExplained: In the final act, Colt discovers that Tom Ryder is alive and was hiding after accidentally killing his stunt double. The real villain is the film's producer, who orchestrated the cover-up to protect the movie's budget. Colt exposes the truth during a chaotic premiere stunt, clears his name, and saves Jody from danger. With the conspiracy unraveled, Colt and Jody finally reunite, and he returns to stunt work with a renewed sense of purpose and love.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action comedies with heart and romance.
